reviews.text: The clinic is excellent; I always feel at ease with the care my cats receive there. The staff has always been attentive and professional, even with my most skittish cat, I feel confident there. Dr. Giovanna and Camila have always been very careful with them.

We needed emergency care for our dog who injured her paw. The service and veterinarians were quick, efficient, and very attentive. They also offer payment plans. Thank you so much, we're so glad we found you.
Excellent service. Highly recommend!
They said my cat had back pain, when in fact it was pyelonephritis, which I discovered with an ultrasound that same day elsewhere. They should have veterinarians with more knowledge about cats.

I chose to take Mel to VetDomus's emergency veterinary care precisely because I saw good reviews here on Google. And the service exceeded expectations!! The consultation included the possibility of a follow-up appointment, and the clinic already offers the necessary tests. Dr. Gabi was very kind to Mel and made us feel very safe during the physical exam, procedures, and follow-up. We were very happy and reassured by this care. We will definitely return.

I only found incredible people, super attentive, caring, and willing to help with everything I need for my little one. So happy to have found a place so concerned with the well-being of animals and such dedicated humans! Thank you so much to everyone, and Vet Pam, you have a special place in all our hearts!

I have no words to thank the entire team at Vet Domus 24H Veterinary Center. Our English Bulldog, Apollo, was bitten by an insect and arrived at the hospital in an extremely critical state.

From the very first second, the care was impeccable, quick, and very humane. They immediately started him on oxygen, implemented a rigorous pain protocol, and performed detailed examinations. The monitoring was so perfect that his internal organs were completely shielded and protected from the venom. Even when the case required delicate surgery on his paw to remove the affected tissue, the team was transparent, surgical, and gave us immense security through meticulous cardiac and biochemical tests before any procedure. Apollo was discharged in excellent condition, eating well and with normal kidney function. You didn't just save our four-legged son, you embraced our hearts when we needed it most. Excellent professionals. We recommend them without hesitation."
The Vet Domus team, in addition to being highly specialized, is always very attentive and careful with our pets.
Excellent service
I had an excellent experience at Vet Domus. My cat was cared for with great affection and professionalism, with frequent reports on her health status, returning with any problems resolved.

My puppy woke up this morning vomiting and with diarrhea. He desperately needed an urgent consultation; he was in pain, uncomfortable, and dehydrated. We were seen during the night shift by Dr. Gleicy, who very competently diagnosed and treated him, and even held my pet in her lap while administering the medication. Also during the night shift, she insisted on reviewing my pet's echocardiogram and electrocardiogram and offered a second opinion on another health issue, even though she wasn't obligated to do so. I was immensely happy and satisfied! Dr. Gleicy is an excellent veterinarian, technically skilled and up-to-date. I am a dermatologist, and she explained everything to me very scientifically. I loved her care and want her to continue overseeing Thor's health from now on. Thank you to the entire team as well!

Excellent veterinary hospital! From the first consultation and the care provided by the veterinary team, everyone was very attentive, professional, and caring. You can see the affection and respect for the animals. I was very satisfied with the service and all the assistance. I recommend it!

I want to express my immense gratitude to Dr. Victor and the entire veterinary hospital team.

My dog ​​spent almost two months battling an extremely difficult-to-control case of giardiasis. During that time, I consulted four other veterinarians, but they all insisted on a course of action that I later discovered was worsening the condition instead of resolving it.

Dr. Victor carefully reviewed my dog's entire medical history and tests and guided me based on the most up-to-date scientific literature and leading conferences in the field. He identified that the medication being used was actually causing some of the problems and proposed a much more appropriate approach.

Following his advice, the improvement was extremely rapid. After a real ordeal, I finally found a competent, meticulous, and up-to-date professional who managed to solve the problem efficiently.

I would also like to highlight the excellent work of the entire hospital team, including the pathologists and other professionals. I was always treated with great attention, professionalism, and care, both during follow-up appointments and in emergency situations.

I highly recommend this veterinary hospital to anyone seeking high-quality care. My experience was exceptional, and I will always be very grateful to Dr. Victor and his team for restoring my dog's health.

I've known Dr. Victor for many years, since the beginning of his career, even before he founded this wonderful hospital. He has been caring for my dog ​​Filomena for about eight years and, throughout that time, has always demonstrated great knowledge, dedication, and love for animals.

Filomena was rescued and, due to her history, faced some challenges throughout her life, such as skin problems, excessive itching, episodes of diarrhea, and some suspicions that left us quite worried. But we always found in Dr. Victor a caring professional who assessed each situation very carefully and sought the best alternatives for her.

With his guidance, we adjusted Filomena's diet, care, and management until we found the path that brought her a much better life. Today she is very well, healthy, and happy, enjoying a great quality of life for several years.

I am very grateful to Dr. Victor and the entire Vet Domus team for the care, patience, and professionalism with which they have always cared for my little Filomena and also for us, her family. It's wonderful to know we can count on such competent and dedicated professionals.

I wholeheartedly recommend Vet Domus Veterinary Hospital to anyone looking for reliable, excellent service at a fair price!
Excellent service from reception to veterinary care 👏🙌🐾💜💚💙🙏 Special thanks to nurse Camila, Amauri and Dr. Tatiane... Chrystal 🐾🥰 felt welcomed and respected 👏🙌💕🙏

Wednesday, June 17th, 2026, at 3 AM, I took my puppy to be euthanized, following the referral from my private veterinarian (who also cares for my other 10 pets). At Vet Domus, I was received in the early morning by nurse Erick and Dr. Luisa. I have always been the owner of many pets, therefore I have many experiences in clinics and hospitals, many of them terrible. But Vet Domus and these two professionals were the best people I have ever received. Empathetic, caring, patient, respectful of the moment and my pain. I felt welcomed and, above all, with the feeling that there are still veterinarians who don't put money before love for animals and compassion for people. Thank you.

I've always really liked this clinic, but today I'm sharing my sad experience with the service. My cat is elderly, and we were left without care. First, we were in a feline waiting room from 9:30 to 10:35, then I went up to the consultation room and waited there alone with my cat behind me. At 10:55, the room was dirty, and nobody attended to me. I left and finally received care, respect, and attention for my cat.
